verdict.rationale: NY DOS publishes a paper filing rail as a first-party alternative to online filing. A completed Certificate of Incorporation with the $125 statutory fee is forwarded to the Division of Corporations. Supporting pieces are also published: a fillable form (drafting your own is allowed), a credit/debit card authorization form for paper payment, mail-in name searches, expedite tiers, and a phone line for help. However, the evidence never shows the exact street mailing address, and no fax number or fax filing option appears, so the story's "exact addresses, numbers" element is only partly met. Missing for 10: exact mailing address in evidence, fax number/fax filing rail, direct form download links, independent corroboration that the paper rail works when online filing is down.
